patch_description:
Rebalance the data re-uploading strategy from 3 uploads × 2 repeats to 2 uploads × 3 repeats.
This maintains the same total number of variational blocks (6) and similar parameter count, but tests whether fewer data re-encodings with deeper intra-upload circuits converge faster or achieve better accuracy.
The deeper ansatz blocks per upload may allow better feature interaction learning, while fewer uploads reduce redundant encoding overhead.
This exploits the strong pattern observed in previous runs and tests a new depth-parameter trade-off.
